patterns: Death news dominates: 'Patrick Stewart has sadly passed away at the age of 86' 16.2M on DiscussingFilm and 2.6M on FilmUpdates, the biggest posts of the week
Tribute-statement chain: Ian McKellen 5.29M, Marvel's 'final performance as Professor X in Avengers: Doomsday' 1.82M, American Dad 1.57M, Hugh Jackman 936k, Marvel statement 743k, Shatner 356k
Bare one-liners win on grief days: 'A Legend Is Gone. An Icon Is Lost.' 45.9k, CinemaTweets1's best of the day, and FilmUpdates' lone 🖤 323k
Game-to-screen keeps pulling: Elder Scrolls VI 'Sentinel' 2.74M, Death Stranding anime trailer 2.13M, OD: KNOCK poster 1.18M, Mouthwashing movie 977k, PUBG series 660k
James Gunn quote drip: Polka-Dot Man prequel 1.55M, Harley Quinn up to Margot Robbie 1.34M, Batman casting soon 1.19M
Doomsday merch and looks stay steady: Doom with the Latverian Witches 723k, Doom's Throne popcorn bucket 498k
Halloween hooks: Curry Barker's MAMA BEAR short 839k, Tubi hearse rides 222k; CinemaTweets1 leaned on personal horror picks (The Thing, The Exorcist)
ATRightMovies steady 10k to 62k: Picard 'Measure of a Man' speech 62k; reply-bait image posts get 30 to 69 replies each
narrative_synthesis: Patrick Stewart's death took over the whole watchlist: DiscussingFilm's announcement hit 16.2M and Ian McKellen's statement 5.29M, with a chain of tributes and Marvel confirming his last role is Professor X in Avengers: Doomsday. Outside that, game adaptations ruled (Elder Scrolls VI 'Sentinel' 2.74M, Death Stranding anime 2.13M) and James Gunn's DCU quotes kept landing above 1M.
